Rat Feeder

The Right Rat Feeder for Your
Research

Every Innocage® rat cage requires a food tray. We oﬀer various options for you to choose from that are compatible with a standard Rat bottom (R-BTM-H), large Mouse bottom (M-BTM-XL), or an extra-large. Rat bottom (R-BTM-XL). Choose the configuration that’s right for your protocol.
  • Research-Ready
  • Disposable & Reusable Options
  • Delivered Irradiated
MOUSE ENRICHMENT

Product Specifications

R-WIRE-HB

Reusable stainless steel wirebar

Wire bar that protects the water bottle and holds food, for use with a standard rat cage configuration.
  • Integrated water bottle protection
  • Food hopper section
  • Stainless steel & Reusable
  • Compatible bottom: R-BTM-H
  • Compatible lids: RVX6, RVX62, RSX1
R-FEED-U

Disposable plastic feeder

Single-use recyclable plastic feeder with a metal insert and for use with rat water bottle protector (R-WBP) in a standard rat change configuration.
  • 100% PET
  • BPA-free
  • Recyclable
  • Compatible bottom: R-BTM-H, R-BTM-A-H, M-BTM-XL
  • Compatible lids: RVX6, RVX62, RVX5, RSX1
R-WBP

Rat water bottle protector

Reusable water bottle protector for use with rat plastic feeder (R-FEED-U) in a standard rat change configuration
  • Protects against water bottle chewing
  • Stainless steel
  • Compatible bottom: R-BTM-H, M-BTM-XL,
  • Compatible lids: RVX6, RVX62, RSX1
R-WIRE-HB

Reusable stainless steel wirebar

Wire bar that protects the water bottle and holds food, for use with a standard rat cage configuration.
  • Integrated water bottle protection
  • Food hopper section
  • Stainless steel & Reusable
  • Compatible bottom: R-BTM-H
  • Compatible lids: RVX6, RVX62, RSX1
R-WIRE-XL

Reusable Tall XL connector

Connector bar used to join two (2) tall rat wirebars (R-WIRE-TD) for Tall Rat XL cage configuration
  • Stainless steel
  • Reusable
  • Compatible bottom: R-BTM-XL
  • Compatible lid: RV7XL
